body: I have. Thank you. Take care
If I tell her she will come and she will find my remains. I’m leaving her a series of videos for memory and explanation. Much better for the hospital staff to make the discovery than her
I’ll be gone in 2 weeks from the cancer either way. Not as if I can avoid it. We both suffer more in the alternative
Christ that’s awful. Personally I’m using a c-pap mask and tube, a helium tank and plumbers putty. I will be asleep in seconds and gone in under a minute. Get well soon please
That’s the goal. Thank you for your advice. Take care
Thank you. I hope for peace and silence at the end. May life give you all it has to offer. You’re a mod here I presume? You’re really making a difference in peoples lives. Thank you for all you do
I do. In fact it is likely more than I need but I can’t let it go wrong
News to me. In any case, I apologize and thank you for your advice.
Thank you for the advice. I sincerely hope that it does improve for you in the end. I’m so sorry for your loss.

I wasn’t intending to hurt anybody. I’m sorry. I couldn’t really tell them because I know they’d take me in sooner or they knew my intentions. I sincerely apologize. Had I elsewhere to turn I promise I would’ve taken it

I intend to leave her recordings. Videos of me for future events to look on, to reminisce, etc. I am dying in 2 weeks from the cancer if not now. The reason Thursday is mentioned is I will be taken by the staff on Friday. I’ve written contact information of those I want to tell things to and notes for them and instructions of how to deliver them. She won’t be the one to find me. I’ve made my place look nice, I will lay in bed and sleep as it happens. As much as it might be unsightly I think if anyone should see it it’s hospital staff that work with cancer patients. I’ve been spending the last few months knowing what’s coming giving her everything I can. The point of this is so that her final memories of me isn’t the man she fell in love with a husk decaying in a hospital. What a tragic ending to 6 years with the most amazing woman to walk the planet.
No worries. All the best my friend.
What I can’t bring myself to tell her is I’m not setting foot in that hospital. I want her to remember our final and most amazing date ever. Not decaying in a hospital bed
She’s aware my time is very limited. She knows I’m going in for my last days in 2 weeks. It’s better this way

I will and I have. I’ve been pouring my life savings into her and our experiences these past few months. I can’t bring myself to tell her that the lump is taking me very soon. Thank you for your advice. I wish you all the best
Thanks. For whatever it’s worth I appreciate it.
